Integer.Name: Width
Integer.Description: Output dimensions. With FPGA processing/scaler enabled, InputWidth/InputHeight and ROI select sensor input; Polyphase supports bounded enlargement. Otherwise uses native sensor geometry/scaling. Stop before changes.

Integer.Name: Height
Integer.Description: Output dimensions. With FPGA processing/scaler enabled, InputWidth/InputHeight and ROI select sensor input; Polyphase supports bounded enlargement. Otherwise uses native sensor geometry/scaling. Stop before changes.

Enumeration.Name: PixelFormat
Enumeration.Description: Native CSI capture or optional FPGA RAW10-derived RGB/BGR and YUV processing on available hardware. With FPGA processing disabled, RGB8/BGR8 use sensor YUV422 and CPU conversion. YUV444 remains limited to 640x480. Custom formats are documented byte layouts, not standard PFNC. RAW uses an unbinned crop with fixed BG phase; ReverseX/Y are locked in RAW. Output format and payload can change sensor cadence and Ethernet limits.

Integer.Name: Timestamp
Integer.Description: Software device counter in nanoseconds with 1000 ns resolution. Frame timestamps mark DMA arm time, not exposure/SOF; no PTP synchronization is implemented.

Integer.Name: TimestampLatchValue
Integer.Description: Software device counter in nanoseconds with 1000 ns resolution. Frame timestamps mark DMA arm time, not exposure/SOF; no PTP synchronization is implemented.

Float.Name: DeviceTemperature
Float.Description: FPGA die temperature from board ADC, not the image sensor temperature.

Float.Name: FanStartTemperature
Float.Description: Hardware hysteresis upper threshold. Must exceed FanStopTemperature.

Float.Name: FanStopTemperature
Float.Description: Hardware hysteresis lower threshold. Must be below FanStartTemperature.

Integer.Name: FanDutyCycle
Integer.Description: PWM duty when hardware thermal hysteresis enables the fan. No tachometer/RPM feedback is wired.

Integer.Name: StatusLEDs
Integer.Description: Logical active-high status bits: 0 heartbeat, 1 sensor ready, 2 GigE ready, 3 streaming blink on images with independent video reset (version 10 and later). Physical LEDs are active-low.

Integer.Name: SensorInputClock
Integer.Description: Configured 12MHz module XCLK assumption, supported by measured frame timing.

Float.Name: AcquisitionFrameRate
Float.Description: Sensor frame rate limit through vertical blanking only; clocks remain unchanged. Actual transmitted rate can be lower because of conversion or network bandwidth.

Float.Name: ExposureTime
Float.Description: Exposure in microseconds; Line period follows the active image mode. Stop acquisition and set ExposureAuto=Off to change.

Enumeration.Name: BalanceWhiteAuto
Enumeration.Description: Continuous AWB is available in ISP formats. RAW has no valid AWB statistics; entering RAW seeds manual unity gains. Legacy RAW presets load with AWB Off and their saved gains.

Integer.Name: SensorIspControl0
Integer.Description: Masked sensor ISP control. Reserved bits are preserved.

Integer.Name: SensorIspControl1
Integer.Description: Masked sensor ISP control. Reserved bits are preserved.

Integer.Name: SensorIspControl3
Integer.Description: Masked sensor ISP control. Reserved bits are preserved.

Integer.Name: EffectEnableBits
Integer.Description: Staged setting. Stop acquisition then execute EffectApply to commit all effect parameters.

Integer.Name: EffectHueCos
Integer.Description: Staged setting. Stop acquisition then execute EffectApply to commit all effect parameters.

Integer.Name: EffectHueSin
Integer.Description: Staged setting. Stop acquisition then execute EffectApply to commit all effect parameters.

Integer.Name: EffectU
Integer.Description: Staged setting. Stop acquisition then execute EffectApply to commit all effect parameters.

Integer.Name: EffectV
Integer.Description: Staged setting. Stop acquisition then execute EffectApply to commit all effect parameters.

Integer.Name: EffectYOffset
Integer.Description: Staged setting. Stop acquisition then execute EffectApply to commit all effect parameters.

Integer.Name: EffectContrast
Integer.Description: Staged setting. Stop acquisition then execute EffectApply to commit all effect parameters.

Integer.Name: EffectBrightness
Integer.Description: Staged setting. Stop acquisition then execute EffectApply to commit all effect parameters.

Integer.Name: EffectSigns
Integer.Description: Staged setting. Stop acquisition then execute EffectApply to commit all effect parameters.

Integer.Name: EffectManualSaturation
Integer.Description: Staged setting. Stop acquisition then execute EffectApply to commit all effect parameters.

Integer.Name: EffectUvThreshold1
Integer.Description: Staged setting. Stop acquisition then execute EffectApply to commit all effect parameters.

Integer.Name: EffectUvThreshold2
Integer.Description: Staged setting. Stop acquisition then execute EffectApply to commit all effect parameters.

Integer.Name: GammaPointSelector
Integer.Description: Staged table setting; execute the corresponding Apply command while stopped.

Integer.Name: GammaPointValue
Integer.Description: Staged table setting; execute the corresponding Apply command while stopped.

Integer.Name: GammaControl
Integer.Description: Staged table setting; execute the corresponding Apply command while stopped.

Integer.Name: LensCorrectionSelector
Integer.Description: Staged table setting; execute the corresponding Apply command while stopped.

Integer.Name: LensCorrectionValue
Integer.Description: Staged table setting; execute the corresponding Apply command while stopped.

Integer.Name: LensCorrectionEnable
Integer.Description: Staged table setting; execute the corresponding Apply command while stopped.

Boolean.Name: SensorVcmAvailable
Boolean.Description: Per-unit capability. Enable only for a module with a wired VCM actuator.

Enumeration.Name: SensorRegisterSelector
Enumeration.Description: Named register catalogue from Ov5640Registers.h. Register values require stopped acquisition.

Command.Name: SensorFeatureApply
Command.Description: Stopped-only masked write to supported ISP/analog image-control ranges. Clock/reset/format/OTP/MCU registers are write-protected.

Command.Name: SensorOtpRefresh
Command.Description: Refresh the 32-byte OTP shadow. Read only; never programs OTP.

Boolean.Name: SensorJpegAvailable
Boolean.Description: JPEG transport is implemented in the matching CSI-byte production image; select VGA YUYV and ImageCompressionMode=JPEG.

Boolean.Name: SensorFrexAvailable
Boolean.Description: Unavailable until the corresponding board/transport integration is qualified.

Boolean.Name: SensorMcuFirmwareAvailable
Boolean.Description: Unavailable until the corresponding board/transport integration is qualified.

Boolean.Name: SensorOtpValid
Boolean.Description: The OTP read shadow becomes valid after SensorOtpRefresh succeeds.

Float.Name: ResultingFrameRate
Float.Description: Nominal sensor rate from current HTS/VTS, not network delivery FPS.

Integer.Name: AutoExposureTarget
Integer.Description: Average-luminance target in sensor units; updates stable and fast AEC thresholds.

Integer.Name: SensorSharpness
Integer.Description: Manual CIP strength in sensor register units. Has no effect on RAW output.

Integer.Name: SensorDenoise
Integer.Description: Manual CIP strength in sensor register units. Has no effect on RAW output.

Enumeration.Name: SensorSharpnessAuto
Enumeration.Description: Selects automatic CIP threshold; manual strength takes effect when Off.

Enumeration.Name: SensorDenoiseAuto
Enumeration.Description: Selects automatic CIP threshold; manual strength takes effect when Off.

Integer.Name: SensorAverageLuminance
Integer.Description: Sensor AEC weighted luminance readout; refreshed with live telemetry.

Command.Name: UserSetSave
Command.Description: Save UserSet1..7. Default is read-only through this standard command; factory provisioning uses the password-protected FactoryUserSetSave command.

Enumeration.Name: ImageCompressionMode
Enumeration.Description: JPEG requires VGA YUYV. Select 640x480 YUV422_YUYVPacked first. GVSP payload type JPEG; PayloadSize is maximum allocation, each leader carries actual encoded length.

Integer.Name: SensorJpegQuality
Integer.Description: OV5640 quantization scale, smaller values give higher quality/larger encoded frames.

Boolean.Name: DeviceConfigurationPending
Boolean.Description: Network/identity changes are journaled automatically while stopped. IP mode and identity apply on the next firmware boot.

Command.Name: DeviceReset
Command.Description: Asynchronously return to the power-up configuration: reset sensor/video and protocol, load UserSetDefault, and apply saved network/identity. Acquisition and ownership are released. Rediscover/reconnect after completion.

Boolean.Name: SensorTelemetryDeferred
Boolean.Description: High-bandwidth streaming defers SCCB telemetry above 105 MB/s to preserve delivered FPS. Cached values refresh during supported active acquisition or synchronous sensor operations; stopped background reads are disabled.

Command.Name: FactoryUserSetSave
Command.Description: Factory maintenance only: save the current profile into the factory slot. Requires UserSetSelector=Default and an unlocked factory password. Not part of standard UserSetSave.

Integer.Name: FpgaProcessingCapabilities
Integer.Description: Integrated PL capabilities: bit 0 black-level subtraction, bit 1 Bayer bad-pixel correction, bit 2 manual gains, bit 3 RGB demosaic, bit 4 RGB median, bit 5 ROI/area downscale, bit 6 CCM, bit 7 gamma, bit 8 FPGA AWB/statistics, bit 9 bilateral filtering, bit 10 sharpening, bit 11 RAW lens shading, bit 12 focus/motion analysis, bit 13 RGB-to-YUV output, bit 14 Xilinx polyphase resampling, bit 15 local contrast with shared RAW preprocessing, bit 16 adaptive RGB display tone mapping, bit 17 bounded integer-map remapping, bit 18 four-byte-per-clock framebuffer writer. Capability bits describe the installed FPGA image.

Boolean.Name: FpgaProcessingEnable
Boolean.Description: Applied at the next AcquisitionStart while stopped. Processing supports BayerBG10/BayerBG10p and, when color capability is present, RGB8/BGR8. Other formats use byte bypass.

Boolean.Name: FpgaBadPixelCorrectionEnable
Boolean.Description: Applied at the next AcquisitionStart while stopped. Processing supports BayerBG10/BayerBG10p and, when color capability is present, RGB8/BGR8. Other formats use byte bypass.

Integer.Name: FpgaBlackLevel
Integer.Description: 10-bit RAW black offset before BPC and gains. On audited v9/v10 active RAW processing, a live write applies to a subsequent complete HLS frame without restarting acquisition. Readback is the requested setting, not a frame-tagged applied value. Otherwise configure while stopped; applies at next AcquisitionStart.

Float.Name: FpgaBalanceRed
Float.Description: Q8.8 Bayer gain, unity 1.0. Applied after BPC, saturated to 10 bits. Applies at next AcquisitionStart.

Float.Name: FpgaBalanceGreen
Float.Description: Q8.8 Bayer gain, unity 1.0. Applied after BPC, saturated to 10 bits. Applies at next AcquisitionStart.

Float.Name: FpgaBalanceBlue
Float.Description: Q8.8 Bayer gain, unity 1.0. Applied after BPC, saturated to 10 bits. Applies at next AcquisitionStart.

Boolean.Name: FpgaProcessingActive
Boolean.Description: True during acquisition when a supported RAW10 or RGB processing path is selected.

Boolean.Name: FpgaMedianAvailable
Boolean.Description: Reports whether the installed FPGA image includes this RGB processing block.

Boolean.Name: FpgaScalerAvailable
Boolean.Description: Reports whether the installed FPGA image includes this RGB processing block.

Boolean.Name: FpgaMedianEnable
Boolean.Description: Applied at the next AcquisitionStart. Requires FPGA processing and RGB8/BGR8 or supported FPGA YUV output.

Boolean.Name: FpgaScalerEnable
Boolean.Description: Applied at the next AcquisitionStart. Requires FPGA processing and RGB8/BGR8 or supported FPGA YUV output.

Boolean.Name: FpgaRoiEnable
Boolean.Description: Applied at the next AcquisitionStart. Requires FPGA processing and RGB8/BGR8 or supported FPGA YUV output.

Integer.Name: FpgaInputWidth
Integer.Description: Input and ROI dimensions for FPGA color resampling. Width/Height select output size. ROI must fit the RAW input. Area mode only reduces; Polyphase permits up to 4x enlargement per ROI axis within the 2592x1944 output bounds. Mixed up/down axes are supported. Validated at AcquisitionStart.

Integer.Name: FpgaInputHeight
Integer.Description: Input and ROI dimensions for FPGA color resampling. Width/Height select output size. ROI must fit the RAW input. Area mode only reduces; Polyphase permits up to 4x enlargement per ROI axis within the 2592x1944 output bounds. Mixed up/down axes are supported. Validated at AcquisitionStart.

Integer.Name: FpgaRoiOffsetX
Integer.Description: Input and ROI dimensions for FPGA color resampling. Width/Height select output size. ROI must fit the RAW input. Area mode only reduces; Polyphase permits up to 4x enlargement per ROI axis within the 2592x1944 output bounds. Mixed up/down axes are supported. Validated at AcquisitionStart.

Integer.Name: FpgaRoiOffsetY
Integer.Description: Input and ROI dimensions for FPGA color resampling. Width/Height select output size. ROI must fit the RAW input. Area mode only reduces; Polyphase permits up to 4x enlargement per ROI axis within the 2592x1944 output bounds. Mixed up/down axes are supported. Validated at AcquisitionStart.

Integer.Name: FpgaRoiWidth
Integer.Description: Input and ROI dimensions for FPGA color resampling. Width/Height select output size. ROI must fit the RAW input. Area mode only reduces; Polyphase permits up to 4x enlargement per ROI axis within the 2592x1944 output bounds. Mixed up/down axes are supported. Validated at AcquisitionStart.

Integer.Name: FpgaRoiHeight
Integer.Description: Input and ROI dimensions for FPGA color resampling. Width/Height select output size. ROI must fit the RAW input. Area mode only reduces; Polyphase permits up to 4x enlargement per ROI axis within the 2592x1944 output bounds. Mixed up/down axes are supported. Validated at AcquisitionStart.

Boolean.Name: SensorRawActive
Boolean.Description: The sensor uses its Bayer RAW tap, including FPGA RGB conversion. Sensor AWB and orientation are unavailable in this mode.

Enumeration.Name: FpgaBalanceWhiteAuto
Enumeration.Description: FPGA gray-world AWB: previous-frame admitted samples, gains 0.25x to 4x, quarter-step smoothing, green reference unity. Dark/saturated frames hold gains. Restart resets AWB to unity.

Integer.Name: FpgaColorTransformationSelector
Integer.Description: Stopped-only table selector. Matrix order is RGB rows then RGB columns. Channel order is red, green, blue.

Integer.Name: FpgaColorOffsetSelector
Integer.Description: Stopped-only table selector. Matrix order is RGB rows then RGB columns. Channel order is red, green, blue.

Integer.Name: FpgaGammaChannel
Integer.Description: Stopped-only table selector. Matrix order is RGB rows then RGB columns. Channel order is red, green, blue.

Integer.Name: FpgaGammaIndex
Integer.Description: Stopped-only table selector. Matrix order is RGB rows then RGB columns. Channel order is red, green, blue.

Float.Name: FpgaColorTransformationValue
Float.Description: Signed Q20 coefficient or DN offset in [-8,8). Applied before RGB8 conversion; vendor Q8 product intermediates and truncation apply.

Float.Name: FpgaColorOffsetValue
Float.Description: Signed Q20 coefficient or DN offset in [-8,8). Applied before RGB8 conversion; vendor Q8 product intermediates and truncation apply.

Integer.Name: FpgaGammaValue
Integer.Description: Selected channel/index RGB8 LUT value. Default is identity. All 768 LUT bytes persist in UserSet.

Command.Name: FpgaStatisticsLatch
Command.Description: Snapshot the latest complete FPGA frame statistics. Allowed during acquisition; read fields remain stable until the next latch.

Integer.Name: FpgaStatisticsSequence
Integer.Description: Latched complete-frame statistics. Sequence restarts at acquisition reset and is not the GVSP FrameID.

Integer.Name: FpgaStatisticsValidPixels
Integer.Description: Latched complete-frame statistics. Sequence restarts at acquisition reset and is not the GVSP FrameID.

Integer.Name: FpgaClippedPixels
Integer.Description: Latched complete-frame statistics. Sequence restarts at acquisition reset and is not the GVSP FrameID.

Integer.Name: FpgaDarkPixels
Integer.Description: Latched complete-frame statistics. Sequence restarts at acquisition reset and is not the GVSP FrameID.

Float.Name: FpgaBalanceMeanRed
Float.Description: Latched Q16 mean. Color means precede gains/CCM and exclude samples with any channel below 8 or at least 1000 DN. Intensity is output RGB8 luma.

Float.Name: FpgaBalanceMeanGreen
Float.Description: Latched Q16 mean. Color means precede gains/CCM and exclude samples with any channel below 8 or at least 1000 DN. Intensity is output RGB8 luma.

Float.Name: FpgaBalanceMeanBlue
Float.Description: Latched Q16 mean. Color means precede gains/CCM and exclude samples with any channel below 8 or at least 1000 DN. Intensity is output RGB8 luma.

Float.Name: FpgaIntensityMean
Float.Description: Latched Q16 mean. Color means precede gains/CCM and exclude samples with any channel below 8 or at least 1000 DN. Intensity is output RGB8 luma.

Float.Name: FpgaAppliedBalanceRed
Float.Description: Latched gains actually applied to the completed frame, independent of configured manual gains during AWB.

Float.Name: FpgaAppliedBalanceGreen
Float.Description: Latched gains actually applied to the completed frame, independent of configured manual gains during AWB.

Float.Name: FpgaAppliedBalanceBlue
Float.Description: Latched gains actually applied to the completed frame, independent of configured manual gains during AWB.

Boolean.Name: FpgaBilateralEnable
Boolean.Description: AMD 3x3 RGB bilateral filter after gamma/median and before ROI/scaling. Replicate border; disabled by default.

Integer.Name: FpgaBilateralSigmaColor
Integer.Description: RGB bilateral range sigma; default 24 DN.

Float.Name: FpgaBilateralSigmaSpace
Float.Description: RGB bilateral spatial sigma; Q8 value, default 1 pixel.

Float.Name: FpgaSharpenStrength
Float.Description: RGB cross-Laplacian strength [0,1] using AMD filter2D, saturated per channel. Zero bypasses. Constant-zero filter border can brighten image edges; assess halos and noise amplification.

Boolean.Name: FpgaLensShadingEnable
Boolean.Description: Programmable RAW10 lens shading after black/BPC and before demosaic or RAW manual gains. Four-phase 7x9 bilinear Q12 grid; default disabled with unity table. A real uniform-field calibration is required for optical correction.

Enumeration.Name: FpgaLensShadingPhase
Enumeration.Description: BGGR calibration plane; the two green CFA phases have independent tables.

Float.Name: FpgaLensShadingGain
Float.Description: Selected grid gain in [0,4], Q12 rounded interpolation and saturated RAW10 output. Default 1x. All 252 gains persist in UserSet; selectors do not.

Boolean.Name: FpgaSceneAnalysisEnable
Boolean.Description: Post-ROI RGB luma focus/motion diagnostics. Both output dimensions must be at least 32 for analysis; smaller images pass with zero/invalid metrics. First frame after acquisition restart has invalid motion. Illumination changes can trigger motion, and noise can increase focus.

Float.Name: FpgaFocusMean
Float.Description: Mean absolute four-neighbor luma Laplacian over the output interior, Q16 DN. Sensitive to ISP settings and noise. Latched with the common completed-frame statistics sequence.

Float.Name: FpgaMotionMean
Float.Description: Mean absolute difference of current/previous 32x32 luma-bin means, Q16 DN. First frame is invalid. Latched with the common completed-frame statistics sequence.

Boolean.Name: FpgaMotionValid
Boolean.Description: Latched valid preceding-frame comparison. False when analysis is disabled, dimensions are below 32, or history was reset.

Enumeration.Name: FpgaYuvRange
Enumeration.Description: BT.601 output levels for the FPGA RGB-to-YUV path. PixelFormat selects YUV444, four averaged-chroma YUV422 orders or legacy 2x2-chroma YUV420. Requires FPGA processing enabled and RAW10 sensor acquisition; native sensor YUV bypass retains its own timing and levels. RGB/BGR bypass is unchanged. Default Limited.

Enumeration.Name: FpgaScalerInterpolation
Enumeration.Description: Resample RGB/BGR or FPGA YUV using Area (default, downscale only) or six-tap, 64-phase Xilinx VPSS. Polyphase allows up to 4x enlargement per ROI axis, within 2592x1944 output and PixelFormat alignment limits. Larger downscale ratios use an area prefilter. Mixed up/down axes are supported. Equal geometry bypasses VPSS; an unchanged axis uses identity coefficients. Configure while stopped; output pixel rate and Ethernet payload can limit FPS.

Boolean.Name: FpgaLocalContrastEnable
Boolean.Description: Four-by-four-tile Xilinx CLAHE on RGB value, after optional scaling. Preserves RGB ratios with bounded fixed-point rounding; black remains black. Requires color FPGA processing, output dimensions at least 32, height multiple of 4 and width multiple of 8. Uses the preceding frame histogram; first frame after Start, geometry/clip change or reset bypasses. Can amplify noise or react to illumination changes. Default off; no optical calibration is implied.

Integer.Name: FpgaLocalContrastClipLimit
Integer.Description: Integer Xilinx CLAHE histogram clip multiplier, 1 through 8, default 4. Higher values allow stronger contrast/noise amplification. Configure while stopped.

Boolean.Name: FpgaBlackLevelLiveActive
Boolean.Description: True only while healthy audited v9/v10 FPGA RAW processing accepts frame-latched live Black Level writes. False during stop/drain/recovery, bypass and legacy processing. Other controls retain their existing locks.

Boolean.Name: FpgaUpscaleAvailable
Boolean.Description: Firmware supports bounded enlargement using the installed VPSS (processing v8 or later). Requires processing/scaler enabled and Polyphase selected. No additional FPGA resources; camera FPS acceptance is separate.

Integer.Name: FpgaUpscaleMaximum
Integer.Description: Maximum supported enlargement per ROI axis: 4 with VPSS, otherwise 1 (no enlargement). Output remains at most 2592x1944 and subject to PixelFormat alignment and link bandwidth. Area never enlarges.

Boolean.Name: FpgaAdaptiveToneAvailable
Boolean.Description: Matching v11 image includes the adaptive RGB display curve after CLAHE and before final scene statistics/output packing. This is not HDR radiance reconstruction.

Boolean.Name: FpgaAdaptiveToneEnable
Boolean.Description: Opt-in shared per-channel rational RGB8 curve driven by preceding input-frame weighted luma. Black/white endpoints fixed; gain 0.5x to 2x changes by at most 1/16 per frame. Can change color ratios and temporal brightness. First/start/reset/dimension/target-change frame bypasses. Configure while stopped. Default off; requires color FPGA processing.

Integer.Name: FpgaAdaptiveToneTarget
Integer.Description: Desired preceding-input weighted-luma mean, (R+2G+B)/4, default 128. Target is a bounded adaptation reference, not guaranteed output brightness. Configure while stopped; new acquisition resets history.

Float.Name: FpgaAdaptiveToneAppliedGain
Float.Description: Unlatched current HLS invocation gain; unity before first valid invocation. Not associated with a specific GVSP frame or common statistics latch.

Integer.Name: FpgaAdaptiveTonePreviousMean
Integer.Description: Unlatched preceding input-frame weighted-luma mean used by the current HLS invocation. First/reset invocation reports zero. Not frame-tagged; gain/mean reads are not an atomic pair.

Boolean.Name: FpgaDistortionAvailable
Boolean.Description: Matching image/control support for bounded640x480 nearest correction, +/-7 source rows. Does not imply calibrated lens parameters.

Boolean.Name: FpgaDistortionEnable
Boolean.Description: Volatile correction enable. Requires a completely validated map matching current color geometry. Default off; full-resolution bypass remains supported. Not saved in UserSet.

Integer.Name: FpgaDistortionMapWidth
Integer.Description: Staged map dimension. Set only after Abort, before Begin, with correction disabled. Must match output geometry; no implicit scaling.

Integer.Name: FpgaDistortionMapHeight
Integer.Description: Staged map dimension. Set only after Abort, before Begin, with correction disabled. Must match output geometry; no implicit scaling.

Integer.Name: FpgaDistortionExpectedCrc32
Integer.Description: CRC32 of raster little-endian32-bit map words, polynomial0xedb88320, standard initial/final XOR. Set before Begin; integrity check is not optical calibration.

Command.Name: FpgaDistortionMapBegin
Command.Description: Volatile map transfer command. Begin selects a staging bank; Commit starts bounded asynchronous validation; Abort invalidates staging without releasing a bank the reader may still access. Configure while stopped and disabled.

Command.Name: FpgaDistortionMapCommit
Command.Description: Volatile map transfer command. Begin selects a staging bank; Commit starts bounded asynchronous validation; Abort invalidates staging without releasing a bank the reader may still access. Configure while stopped and disabled.

Command.Name: FpgaDistortionMapAbort
Command.Description: Volatile map transfer command. Begin selects a staging bank; Commit starts bounded asynchronous validation; Abort invalidates staging without releasing a bank the reader may still access. Configure while stopped and disabled.

Integer.Name: FpgaDistortionMapIndex
Integer.Description: Raster map word index. Upload sequentially; explicit index/value pairs make identical retries idempotent.

Integer.Name: FpgaDistortionMapData
Integer.Description: Map word: valid bit31, source x bits9:0, source y bits18:10, reserved bits30:19 zero. Zero means black. Coordinates must be in bounds and within seven source rows; unsupported entries fail validation.

Integer.Name: FpgaDistortionHardwareStatus
Integer.Description: Last observed reader status: bit0 geometry, bit1 map encoding/window, bit2 input framing. Zero alone does not prove successful acquisition.

Integer.Name: MaxAIEnabledFeatures
Integer.Description: Volatile bitmask: face detection, face recognition, objects, plate candidates/OCR, motion, person HOG, QR, tracking. Unsupported bits are rejected. Defaults off. Results use the captured output image coordinates; no accuracy or real-time guarantee.

Integer.Name: MaxAIMinimumScore
Integer.Description: Score threshold in millionths. Model confidence is not calibrated probability.

Integer.Name: MaxAIFaceCosineThreshold
Integer.Description: Cosine similarity threshold in millionths; default0.45 is a starting point requiring validation on your enrollment data.

Integer.Name: MaxAIObjectTextWord0
Integer.Description: Four UTF-8 bytes packed least-significant-byte first. Eight words form a NUL-terminated32-byte label. Applies to identity, OCR or QR; labels may be truncated.

Integer.Name: MaxAIObjectTextWord1
Integer.Description: Four UTF-8 bytes packed least-significant-byte first. Eight words form a NUL-terminated32-byte label. Applies to identity, OCR or QR; labels may be truncated.

Integer.Name: MaxAIObjectTextWord2
Integer.Description: Four UTF-8 bytes packed least-significant-byte first. Eight words form a NUL-terminated32-byte label. Applies to identity, OCR or QR; labels may be truncated.

Integer.Name: MaxAIObjectTextWord3
Integer.Description: Four UTF-8 bytes packed least-significant-byte first. Eight words form a NUL-terminated32-byte label. Applies to identity, OCR or QR; labels may be truncated.

Integer.Name: MaxAIObjectTextWord4
Integer.Description: Four UTF-8 bytes packed least-significant-byte first. Eight words form a NUL-terminated32-byte label. Applies to identity, OCR or QR; labels may be truncated.

Integer.Name: MaxAIObjectTextWord5
Integer.Description: Four UTF-8 bytes packed least-significant-byte first. Eight words form a NUL-terminated32-byte label. Applies to identity, OCR or QR; labels may be truncated.

Integer.Name: MaxAIObjectTextWord6
Integer.Description: Four UTF-8 bytes packed least-significant-byte first. Eight words form a NUL-terminated32-byte label. Applies to identity, OCR or QR; labels may be truncated.

Integer.Name: MaxAIObjectTextWord7
Integer.Description: Four UTF-8 bytes packed least-significant-byte first. Eight words form a NUL-terminated32-byte label. Applies to identity, OCR or QR; labels may be truncated.

Integer.Name: MaxAIResultWidth
Integer.Description: Latched source geometry/configuration, or live elapsed microseconds since that capture was offered. Age saturates at32-bit maximum and is not wall-clock time.

Integer.Name: MaxAIResultHeight
Integer.Description: Latched source geometry/configuration, or live elapsed microseconds since that capture was offered. Age saturates at32-bit maximum and is not wall-clock time.

Integer.Name: MaxAIResultPixelFormat
Integer.Description: Latched source geometry/configuration, or live elapsed microseconds since that capture was offered. Age saturates at32-bit maximum and is not wall-clock time.

Integer.Name: MaxAIResultConfigGeneration
Integer.Description: Latched source geometry/configuration, or live elapsed microseconds since that capture was offered. Age saturates at32-bit maximum and is not wall-clock time.

Integer.Name: MaxAIResultAgeUs
Integer.Description: Latched source geometry/configuration, or live elapsed microseconds since that capture was offered. Age saturates at32-bit maximum and is not wall-clock time.

Float.Name: Gain
Float.Description: Combined sensor gain as a linear multiplier, identical to GainFactor.

Register.Name: DeviceProvisioningRecord
Register.Description: Factory-only atomic 64-byte identity/network record. Provision using tools/gige_provision.py; applied after firmware reboot.

StringReg.Name: FeatureAccessPassword
StringReg.Description: Write-only factory access password. Unlock expires after 300 seconds or when the controlling connection releases ownership. Password is never read back or saved in a UserSet.
